page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with short marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Gathering signature "d 4" at the foot.

main_text.p: filiis exadverso Scipionis & mariti, Scipioni quidem jure belli utenti bene precata esse, maritum vero ut virum sceleratum, patriæ, sacrorum, sui, liberorumque proditorem nefarium omnibus diris devovisse, moxque jugulatos manu sua filios in ignem projecisse, & semet eodem præcipitasse.

Scipio tota jam Carthagine potitus, misso celeriter Romam victoriæ nuncio,atque interea consignato omni auro & argento ac donariis, reliquis cunctis urbis captæ exercitus direptioni per aliquot continuos dies permissis, præmiisque pro singulorum meritis inter milites distribu-[illegible, ~3 letters]tis, exclusis solis fani Apollinis direptoribus[illegible, ~2 letters], præstolatus est senatus populi Romani mandatum. Cumque ad eos[illegible, ~3 letters] venisent decem legati, ex quorum [illegible, ~6 letters] filio res Africæ constituerent, ex decreto ad se per legatos misso, quicquid reliquum Carthaginis erat, diruit funditus: vetuitque, ne qui in solo Carthaginis, inprimis vero Byrsæ & Megarorum, ut habebat decretum, deinceps habitaret, cum imprecatione omnium dirarum in eos, qui contra auderent facere. page.notes: Right margin: several short marginal notes, cramped and partly overlapped by the text and the margin reference marks; their letters are not legible, so they are marked as illegible. Words "ad eos", "quorum c" and "direptoribus" are partly covered by note marks; readings marked [?] or illegible where the overlap hides letters. The line "ex quorum ... filio" is damaged at the line end; the reading "consilio" is likely but not certain, so it is left illegible. Reading of the page number "95" is uncertain. Two digits at the far bottom right of the scan are edge or next-page matter and are not transcribed.
